description.p: Owl Player plays what you have. It is built directly on the FFmpeg libraries — libavformat, libavcodec, libswscale and libswresample — so the list of things it opens is the list of things FFmpeg opens, and it decodes on the GPU wherever the hardware allows.

The picture is drawn by Owl Player's own renderer: decoded frames go straight from the decoder into GL textures, and colour conversion, 10- and 12-bit formats and HDR tone mapping all happen on the GPU. Nothing touches the CPU between the decoder and the screen.
It wears Raven Glass, the look shared with Raven Settings, Store, Viewer and Power, and follows the accent colour you set for the desktop.
